headline: Liverpool pay PSG GBP 106m for Bradley Barcola on deadline eve
facts: Liverpool's season page lists Barcola joining from PSG on 31 August 2026.
The listed fee is GBP 106m, rising to GBP 123m with add-ons.
Liverpool also let Curtis Jones go to Inter and loaned Harvey Elliott to Valencia in the same window.
background: Barcola is a French winger who came through the Lyon academy and joined PSG in 2023. Liverpool have gone through a coaching change this year, with Andoni Iraola appointed in June 2026 after Arne Slot left.

headline: Manchester City sign Enzo Fernandez from Chelsea for GBP 125m
facts: City's season page lists Fernandez joining from Chelsea on 1 September 2026 for GBP 125m.
Chelsea's page also lists the GBP 125m sale to City, but gives no date.
He arrived in the same window City sold Rodri to Barcelona and Nico Gonzalez to Newcastle.
background: Fernandez joined Chelsea from Benfica in January 2023 for a British record fee of about GBP 106.8m, after winning the 2022 World Cup with Argentina. City are now managed by Enzo Maresca, appointed in June 2026 after Pep Guardiola resigned.
footage_terms: Enzo Fernandez Manchester City first goal

headline: Rodri leaves Manchester City for Barcelona on a four-year deal
facts: Barcelona's season page lists Rodri joining from City on 18 August 2026 on a four-year deal.
City's page puts the fee at GBP 65.4m; Barcelona's text says up to EUR 76.5m.
Barcelona's table splits it as EUR 60m plus EUR 15m in variables.
background: Rodri won the 2024 Ballon d'Or while at City and was the engine of their treble side of 2023. The move is two days before the three-month window starts, so use it as the opening beat of the series.

headline: Martinelli leaves Arsenal for Al-Hilal in a GBP 60m record sale
facts: Arsenal's season page says Martinelli joined Al-Hilal for GBP 60m, confirmed about two days after Gabriel Jesus and Fabio Vieira left.
The page calls it Arsenal's record departure.
The date is approximate (about 3 September 2026) because the page says 'two days after' 1 September.
background: Martinelli joined Arsenal in 2019 from Brazilian club Ituano as a teenager and became a regular wide forward. Arsenal were Premier League champions last season, according to ESPN.

headline: Ezri Konsa swaps Aston Villa for Arsenal and debuts against his old club
facts: Konsa joined Arsenal on 21 August 2026 for GBP 51m plus GBP 4m in add-ons, reported as about GBP 55m.
He came on as a substitute in Arsenal's 1-0 win at Aston Villa on 31 August.
The page says he is the first player since Petr Cech in 2015 to debut for a club against the side he had just left.
background: Konsa joined Villa from Brentford in 2019 and grew into an England international. Villa's page notes this is their first season since 2018-19 without him.
footage_terms: Ezri Konsa Arsenal debut Aston Villa

headline: Manchester United sign Carlos Baleba from Brighton for a reported GBP 70m
facts: United's season page lists Baleba joining from Brighton on 25 August 2026 for an undisclosed fee, reported at GBP 70m.
United were 18th and Michael Carrick was sacked on 12 November; Mauricio Pochettino took over on 18 November.
On 7 November United fell into the relegation zone for the first time in Premier League history after nine games.
background: Baleba is a Cameroonian midfielder who joined Brighton from Lille in 2023. United have a long record of big-money midfield signings that did not fix the team.

headline: Savinho goes from Manchester City to Tottenham for GBP 75m
facts: Tottenham's page lists Savinho joining from City on 25 August 2026 for GBP 75m, with up to GBP 10m in add-ons.
City's page lists the same fee and date.
Spurs also sold Cristian Romero to Atletico Madrid and loaned out Guglielmo Vicario and Pape Matar Sarr to Juventus.
background: Savinho joined City from Girona in 2024 after a strong season in Spain. Spurs are 11th in the Premier League as of early November, per their season page.

headline: Omar Marmoush goes on loan from City to Tottenham until the end of the season
facts: City's page lists Marmoush loaned to Tottenham on 27 August 2026.
Tottenham's page lists the loan as running until the end of the season.
It was one of two City attackers who moved to Spurs in the same week, along with Savinho.
background: Marmoush is an Egyptian forward who joined City from Eintracht Frankfurt in January 2025 after a huge goalscoring season in Germany. Now he is on loan to a rival in London.

headline: Jack Grealish loaned from City to Everton for the season
facts: Everton's page lists Grealish on loan from City from 1 September 2026 until the end of the season.
City's page says it is the final year of his City contract.
Everton were 6th in the Premier League on 16 points after 10 games, as of 8 November.
background: Grealish joined City from Aston Villa in 2021 for GBP 100m, then a British record, and won the 2023 treble. Everton's recent rise shows a loan can still be a lifeline.

headline: Iliman Ndiaye leaves Everton for Manchester City in a GBP 60m deal
facts: City's page lists Ndiaye joining from Everton on 1 September 2026 for GBP 60m plus up to GBP 5m in add-ons.
Everton's own page records the sale at GBP 65m.
The same day Jack Grealish moved the other way on loan.
background: Ndiaye is a Senegal winger who has built his name at Marseille and Everton. The swap with Grealish gave Everton a free winger in return for a sold one.

headline: Gabriel Jesus joins Barcelona from Arsenal
facts: Barcelona's page lists Jesus arriving from Arsenal on 1 September 2026 for up to EUR 14m, on a deal to 2029.
He debuted on 6 September in a 5-0 win at Valencia.
Barcelona won their first nine league games, a club record.
background: Jesus joined Arsenal from Manchester City in 2022 and won plenty at City under Guardiola. At Arsenal he often fought injuries and rotation.

headline: Curtis Jones leaves boyhood club Liverpool for Inter
facts: Inter's page lists Jones arriving from Liverpool on 21 August 2026 for EUR 30m plus EUR 5m.
Liverpool's page lists the sale at GBP 25.7m, rising to GBP 30m.
Inter lost 1-3 to AC Milan on 31 October, per the page.
background: Jones came through the Liverpool academy and won the FA Cup and League Cup with the club. Inter are coached by Cristian Chivu this season.

headline: Nicolas Jackson moves from Chelsea to Aston Villa for GBP 47.5m
facts: Villa's page lists Jackson joining on 28 August 2026 for GBP 47.5m plus up to GBP 17.5m in add-ons.
Chelsea's page lists the same fee.
Jackson is Villa's top scorer with six league goals and nine in all competitions as of early November.
background: Jackson joined Chelsea from Villarreal in 2023 and was known for chances missed as well as scored. Villa sold Konsa to Arsenal a week earlier.

headline: Emiliano Martinez leaves Aston Villa for Chelsea for just GBP 7.5m
facts: Villa's page lists Martinez going to Chelsea on 30 August 2026 for GBP 7.5m.
Chelsea's page lists the same fee and date.
Nicolas Jackson moved from Chelsea to Villa two days earlier.
background: Martinez was a World Cup winner with Argentina in 2022 and has played for Villa since 2020 after leaving Arsenal. Chelsea now hold a keeper who is a World Cup winner and a famous trash-talker.
footage_terms: Dibu Martinez World Cup penalty saves

headline: Chelsea sell Liam Delap to Nottingham Forest for GBP 45m
facts: Chelsea's page lists Delap going to Forest on 27 August 2026 for GBP 45m plus up to GBP 5m in add-ons.
Chelsea's page also lists Jackson to Villa, Enzo Fernandez to City and Marc Guiu to RB Leipzig.
Chelsea hired Xabi Alonso on 1 July 2026.
background: Delap came up through the Manchester City academy and joined Chelsea from Ipswich in 2025. Forest are now managed by Oliver Glasner, who was appointed on 6 July 2026.

headline: Nico Gonzalez goes from City to Newcastle for GBP 48m
facts: Newcastle's page lists Gonzalez joining on 26 August 2026 for GBP 47m.
City's page lists GBP 48m plus up to GBP 4m in add-ons.
Newcastle sat 12th in the Premier League as of early November and lost 1-4 at Leeds and at Coventry.
background: Gonzalez joined City from Barcelona in January 2025 as a Rodri stand-in, and Rodri has now left for Barcelona. Newcastle have a new coach, Matthias Jaissle, who replaced Eddie Howe in August 2026.

headline: City buy Ayyoub Bouaddi from Lille for GBP 81m
facts: City's page lists Bouaddi joining on 26 August 2026 for GBP 81.4m; the squad table says GBP 85.6m.
He was City's biggest signing by fee until Enzo Fernandez arrived on 1 September.
City lost 3-0 to Arsenal in the Community Shield on 16 August and then won their first seven league games.
background: Bouaddi is a young central midfielder from Lille. City needed midfield help after Rodri, Nico Gonzalez and Tijjani Reijnders all left.

headline: Newcastle loan Nick Woltemade to Juventus
facts: Juventus's page lists Woltemade on loan from Newcastle to June 2027 on 1 September 2026, with a loan fee of EUR 3.6m.
Newcastle's page lists the loan at GBP 3.5m.
Woltemade has four goals in all competitions for Juventus as of early November, level with Kolo Muani.
background: Newcastle signed Woltemade from Stuttgart in 2025 for a big fee reported at about EUR 75m. Juventus are 7th in Serie A under Luciano Spalletti.

headline: Juventus run a loan-heavy window: Vicario, Grabara, Sarr and Woltemade
facts: Juventus took Vicario on loan from Tottenham on 18 August, with an option to buy for EUR 8m.
They took Grabara from Wolfsburg on 25 August (option EUR 11.5m) and Sarr from Tottenham on 1 September (option EUR 27.5m).
They sent Michele Di Gregorio to Bournemouth and Fabio Miretti to Besiktas, both on loan.
background: Juventus have chosen loans with purchase options over big up-front fees. They have a goalkeeper merry-go-round, with Vicario in and Di Gregorio out.

headline: Leon Goretzka leaves Bayern for Aston Villa on a free
facts: Villa's page lists Goretzka joining on 27 August 2026 as a free transfer.
A separate Bundesliga transfer list also records his move from Bayern to Villa.
Bayern's own transfer table for the period lists no incoming deals.
background: Goretzka joined Bayern from Schalke in 2018 and won the 2020 Champions League with the club. Villa picked up a former Bayern midfielder for nothing.

headline: Cristian Romero leaves Tottenham for Atletico Madrid
facts: Tottenham's page lists Romero going to Atletico on 15 August 2026 for GBP 34.2m.
The page says it is the first Spurs season since 2020-21 without him.
Atletico beat Real Madrid 2-1 in the derby on 20 September, and Barcelona beat Atletico 2-1 away on 8 November.
background: Romero joined Spurs from Atalanta in 2021 and won the 2022 World Cup with Argentina. The date is five days before the three-month window starts, so treat it as background.

headline: Joao Cancelo comes back to Barcelona on a free from Al-Hilal
facts: Barcelona's page lists Cancelo as a free signing from Al-Hilal on 20 August 2026, signed to 2029.
Goalkeeper Dominik Livakovic joined from Fenerbahce about a week later for EUR 4m, through 2030.
Barcelona lost 4-2 at PSG on 20 October, their first defeat of the season.
background: Cancelo played for Barcelona on loan from Manchester City in 2023-24 and later moved to Al-Hilal. The Saudi spell is now over and he is back in Catalonia.

headline: Tijjani Reijnders leaves Manchester City for Al-Qadsiah for GBP 52m
facts: City's page lists Reijnders going to Al-Qadsiah on 19 August 2026 for GBP 52m.
City also sold Mahamadou Sangare to the same Saudi club on 6 September for GBP 1.7m.
Reijnders left within a year of joining City.
background: Reijnders joined City from AC Milan in 2025 after a strong year in Serie A. Saudi money keeps taking players in their prime from top European clubs.

headline: Harvey Elliott loaned from Liverpool to Valencia
facts: Liverpool's page lists Elliott loaned to Valencia on 1 September 2026 until 30 June 2027.
Valencia sacked Carlos Corberan on 13 September when they were 20th and hired Javier Aguirre on 23 September.
Barcelona beat Valencia 5-0 on 6 September.
background: Elliott joined Liverpool from Fulham in 2019 as a teenager and has often been sent out on loan since. Now he plays in La Liga for a club that sacked its coach within two weeks.

headline: Aston Villa buy Ibrahim Mbaye from PSG for GBP 47m
facts: Villa's page lists Mbaye joining from PSG on 1 September 2026 for GBP 47m.
Villa also added Matteo Ruggeri, Zion Suzuki and Taylor Harwood-Bellis in the window.
Villa were 10th in the league and had beaten Fenerbahce 6-0 in the Champions League on 13 October.
background: Mbaye is a young winger from the PSG academy. PSG had also sold Barcola to Liverpool that week, so they cashed in on two forwards in one window.

headline: AC Milan sell Rafael Leao to Galatasaray for EUR 38m
facts: Milan's page lists Leao going to Galatasaray on 29 August 2026 for EUR 38m.
Milan also loaned Nkunku to RB Leipzig and Santiago Gimenez to Porto, with an obligation to buy.
Milan were 4th in Serie A on 24 points after 11 games, as of 8 November.
background: Leao joined Milan from Lille in 2019 and was Serie A's best player when Milan won the 2022 title. Milan have been selling forwards and bringing in winger Diego Moreira.
footage_terms: Rafael Leao AC Milan best goals

headline: Milan pay Strasbourg EUR 45m for winger Diego Moreira
facts: Milan's page lists Moreira arriving from Strasbourg on 19 August 2026.
The fee is EUR 45m plus EUR 20m in add-ons.
Milan beat Inter 3-1 on 31 October in front of 77,691 fans, the Serie A season high so far.
background: Strasbourg and Chelsea share an ownership group, which helps players move between clubs. Milan paid a lot for a player who has little top-flight history.

headline: Arsenal end Reiss Nelson's contract by mutual consent and he joins Feyenoord
facts: Arsenal's page says Nelson's contract was ended by mutual consent on 27 August 2026.
He joined Feyenoord on 2 September 2026.
The page says it leaves Arsenal with their first squad since Arsene Wenger's era with no player who played under him.
background: Nelson is an Arsenal academy graduate who made his debut as a teenager and spent years in and out of the first team, with loans to Hoffenheim and Feyenoord. Feyenoord also lost 1-5 to Barcelona in the Champions League on 9 September.
footage_terms: Reiss Nelson last minute winner Bournemouth

headline: Barcelona's Deco wants Liverpool to turn Ronald Araujo's loan into a EUR 55m buy
facts: ESPN reports Araujo has two goals in 15 games for Liverpool this season.
Liverpool hold an option to make the loan permanent for EUR 55m, with a deadline to use it.
Deco said the clubs could still talk about timing and the fee afterwards, and that Liverpool would need to agree terms with the player.
background: Araujo is a 27-year-old Uruguay defender and a former Barcelona captain, according to ESPN. In the same article Deco denied that Barcelona plan to sell left-back Alejandro Balde, who has played only five matches this season.

headline: Vinicius Junior stays at Real Madrid but looks short of form after a summer of transfer talk
facts: ESPN says Arsenal were the most prominent suitor in a summer of heavy speculation over his future.
Vinicius admitted he trained less than usual and that offers and contract talks distracted him.
He has one goal for Real Madrid this season, after a four-game suspension for pulling Villarreal player Nathan Saliba's hair, but scored five in two Brazil friendlies in November.
background: Vinicius has played for Real Madrid since 2018 and is one of their biggest stars. Real Madrid's club-record signing Yan Diomande, at EUR 125m, now competes with him for the left wing.
footage_terms: Vinicius Junior Brazil hat trick Singapore
Real Madrid Vinicius Villarreal red card
